title: GEISA Metered Quantities Billing Profile v0.9
description: GEISA billing profile for an AC meter or metrology-capable platform that advertises billing support. This profile overlays the base metered quantities schema without replacing it. For validation, it expects a billing quantities payload with delivered active energy summation and delivered active power demand baseline fields, and it treats power factor as an interval/window-qualified summation quantity rather than a demand-total quantity. Reactive, apparent, received, net, tariff-specific, and policy-specific billing fields remain optional in this profile.

geisa-billing-quantities.description: Profile overlay for the top-level GEISA billing quantities payload. It expects delivered active energy summation and delivered active power demand fields, and it keeps power factor in the summation-total interval window rather than in demand-total.

summation-total.description: Required billing summation payload for this profile. The measurement period records the averaging or integration window for interval-derived values, including summation power factor.

demand-total.description: Required billing demand payload for this profile. The measurement period records the averaging or integration window for interval-derived values; it is required here for consistency even though power factor is not modeled under demand-total.
